Here is the protocol-first change set to expose runtime metrics to the client HUD.

### Summary of Changes
1.  **Protocol Definition (`packages/protocol/src/messages.ts`)**: Added a new `ServerMessage` type `runtime.metrics` and its corresponding Zod schema. This defines the contract for the metrics payload.
2.  **Runtime Emission (`apps/game-runtime/src/runtime/GameRuntimeServer.ts`)**: Modified `sendWorldSnapshot` to include the current `RuntimeMetrics` snapshot in the `world.snapshot` payload. This keeps the authority in the runtime and ensures the client receives the data alongside the world state.
3.  **Client Consumption (`apps/game-client/src/App.tsx`)**: Added state to hold metrics and updated the `onmessage` handler to parse the new `world.snapshot` payload.
4.  **Client HUD (`apps/game-client/src/components/GodConsoleSidebar.tsx`)**: Added a new HUD card to display the metrics (Turns, Invalid Outputs, Action Stats, Queue Depth).
5.  **Contract Tests (`apps/game-runtime/test/ui-contract.integration.test.ts`)**: Added a test to verify the `world.snapshot` message includes the `metrics` field and validates the schema.

### Files Changed

#### 1. `packages/protocol/src/messages.ts`
**Change**: Extend `ServerMessage` union and Zod schema to include `runtime.metrics`.

```typescript
// ... existing imports ...

export type ServerMessage =
  // ... existing types ...
  | {
      version: Version;
      type: "world.snapshot";
      payload: {
        tick: number;
        world: {
          width: number;
          height: number;
          seed: number;
          tiles: string[][];
          entities: Array<WorldResourceEntityMessage | WorldCreatureEntityMessage>;
          placements: Array<{ id: string; prefabId: string; x: number; y: number }>;
        };
        agents: Array<{ /* ... */ }>;
        catalog: { /* ... */ };
        metrics: {
          turnsTotal: number;
          invalidOutputCount: number;
          actionAppliedCount: number;
          actionRejectedCount: number;
          queuedActions: number;
        };
      };
    }
  | {
      // ... existing error type ...
    };

// ... existing schemas ...

const worldSnapshotSchema = z.object({
  tick: z.number(),
  world: z.object({
    width: z.number(),
    height: z.number(),
    seed: z.number(),
    tiles: z.array(z.array(z.string())),
    entities: z.array(z.union([
      z.object({ type: z.literal("resource"), subtype: z.string(), x: z.number(), y: z.number(), quantity: z.number() }),
      z.object({ type: z.literal("creature"), subtype: z.string(), x: z.number(), y: z.number(), quantity: z.number(), hp: z.number(), maxHp: z.number(), attack: z.number(), defense: z.number(), aggroRange: z.number(), attackRange: z.number(), cooldownTicks: z.number(), maxCooldownTicks: z.number(), hostile: z.boolean(), behaviorState: z.enum(["idle", "chase", "attack"]) })
    ])),
    placements: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), prefabId: z.string(), x: z.number(), y: z.number() }))
  }),
  agents: z.array(z.object({
    id: z.string(), name: z.string(), x: z.number(), y: z.number(), facing: z.string(), stamina: z.number(), hp: z.number(), maxHp: z.number(), attack: z.number(), defense: z.number(), attackRange: z.number(), cooldownTicks: z.number(), alive: z.boolean(), inventory: z.record(z.number()), score: z.object({ survival: z.number(), progression: z.number(), social: z.number(), total: z.number() }), scoreTrack: z.object({ creatureKills: z.number(), enemyAgentKills: z.number(), successfulLoots: z.number(), crafts: z.number(), structuresPlaced: z.number(), cooperativeTalks: z.number(), tacticalInspects: z.number(), idleStreak: z.number() }), knownPeerInventories: z.record(z.object({ inventory: z.record(z.number()), tick: z.number() })).optional(), nearbyEntities: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), type: z.string(), x: z.number(), y: z.number(), distance: z.number(), hp: z.number().optional(), maxHp: z.number().optional(), hostile: z.boolean().optional() })), relations: z.object({ allies: z.array(z.string()), enemies: z.array(z.string()), neutral: z.array(z.string()) }), inbox: z.array(z.object({ fromAgentId: z.string(), message: z.string(), tick: z.number() })), model: z.string().nullable(), effort: z.string() }),
  catalog: z.object({
    prefabs: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), name: z.string(), kind: z.string() })),
    recipes: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), input: z.array(z.object({ item: z.string(), count: z.number() })), output: z.object({ item: z.string(), count: z.number() }) }))
  }),
  metrics: z.object({
    turnsTotal: z.number(),
    invalidOutputCount: z.number(),
    actionAppliedCount: z.number(),
    actionRejectedCount: z.number(),
    queuedActions: z.number()
  })
});
```
